'''Gold Squadron''' was a unit of three [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] group [[Battle of the Bruanii sector|attacked]] the cruiser [[Lulsla (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Lulsla'']], an [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80]] cruiser that the unit was stationed at. They were destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, largely thanks to the [[TIE pilot]] ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
